title: Preference Optimization Improves Definition Generation: Semantic Change in EU Institutional Sustainable Finance Disclosures
abstract: arXiv:2610.33357v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dictionary-like definition generators are known to be useful for lexical semantic change detection (LSCD). However, they suffer from overly granular sense distribution, producing excessive number of definitions for one and the same lexical sense. In this work, we show that fine-tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) helps to overcome this problem. We test our approach both quantitatively on a curated academic LSCD benchmark and qualitatively on real-world data for a practical task of auditing diachronic changes in sustainability terminology within project documentation of EU development finance. All models, code and predictions produced in this study are publicly available at https://github.com/ltgoslo/dpo-for-definition-generation.

translated_title: 偏好优化改进定义生成：欧盟机构可持续金融披露中的语义变化
translated_abstract: 类词典定义生成器被证实对词汇语义变化检测（LSCD）非常有用。然而，它们存在语义分布过于细粒度的问题，即为同一个词汇语义生成过多的定义。在这项工作中，我们表明使用直接偏好优化（DPO）进行微调有助于克服这一问题。我们在精心整理的学术LSCD基准上进行了定量测试，并在真实世界数据上进行了定性测试，应用于审计欧盟发展金融项目文档中可持续性术语历时变化的实际任务。本研究产生的所有模型、代码和预测结果均在 https://github.com/ltgoslo/dpo-for-definition-generation 公开提供。
tldr: 使用直接偏好优化（DPO）微调定义生成模型可解决同一词义生成过多定义的问题，并成功应用于审计欧盟可持续金融术语的语义变化。
en_tdlr: Fine-tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) overcomes the problem of overly granular sense distribution in definition generation, enabling effective auditing of semantic change in EU sustainable finance terminology.
